skillTree.localised_description: No one haggles like Snarky—his bulk alone earns him discounts, ensuring every gun is cheap to feed and cheaper to keep.
The Empire's Engineers know how best to calibrate their weapons for increased range.
With a roar that rattles kegs, Snarky commands his gunners to unleash a storm of lead, their barrels reloading as swiftly as a hungry ogre swallows meat.
"The enemy's fear; their blood spilt in the mud – these are the things that sustain me."
The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.
Professional soldiery means never running out of ammo at the crucial moment.
This warrior is one with their blade; it is an extension of their will, making them a worthy foe in combat.
What use armour, or even magical defences, against such powerful ordnance?
Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.
A clever arrangement of lenses makes the target seem just that bit closer.
Death is always just a shot away.
The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.
Arrows, cannonballs and more esoteric munitions are needed in endless supply on the battlefield.
A bang, a flash - the foes stagger slowly and blindly whilst you take full advantage of their disarray.
A cluster of small explosions trigger in quick sequence, combining into a fiery blaze of destruction.
"Stand Back! These are Dawr, but this is only the milluzth attempt!"
Devastation rains down from above, leaving no room for respite, but all managed from a reasonably safe distance.
There are Lords that radiate power, confidence and fear, inspiring their followers to great or terrible acts.
